newsitem.title: UK: Sanderson Bramall says Q1 ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Sanderson Bramall says Q1 ahead of budget.

text.p: British automobile distribution company Sanderson Bramall said on Friday its performance in the first quarter this year was was ahead of its expectations and its corresponding performance in the previous year.

"The first three months of this year have been buoyant and the company's pretax profit for the three months is well up on both our budget and also on last year," Sanderson's chairman Tony Bramall told an annual meeting.
The company's share price was marked 6-1/2 pence higher at 253 1/2 moments after Bramall's announcement.
Bramall said margins on its retail sale of new and used cars had increased over the previous year and post-sales business was ahead of expectations.
The company was refurbishing its existing facilities and was expanding its dealership network which would improve its future earnings.
"Whilst it is still early in the year, we feel confindent about another satisfactory outcome for 1997," the chairman said.
